newsitem.title: CHILE: Rains hits Chuquicamata, no long-term effect seen.
newsitem.headline: Rains hits Chuquicamata, no long-term effect seen.

text.p: A heavy rainstorm in northern Chile cut into daily production by 10 to 15 percent at Codelco's Chuquicamata mine but was not strong enough to affect monthly or quarterly output, a spokesman said.
The mine, Codelco's largest, plans to issue a statement sometime Monday on the effects of the Sunday rainstorm, said spokesman Jaime Andrade.

"There won't be any effect on monthly or quarterly production figures from this," he said by telephone from the mine, declining to give The storm, accompanied by strong winds, caused minor flooding and damage to houses in the nearby town of Calama, its mayor said on local television. Electricity and telephone lines were cut in much of northern Chile but were restored by Monday.
